definitions.short: Adnah , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H5734. Adnah עֵדְנָה proper name, masculine 1. a prince of Judah 2Chr 17:14 , ᵐ5 . Εδνα ( α ) ς 2 a Manassite 1Chr 12:21 , probably (reading ׳ע ), with Manuscripts, for עַדְנַח ; van d. H. ᵐ5 עַדְנָח, Εδνα ). — See also עַדְנָא . above
